messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend periods that Canadians can expect in 2023.  (A “long weekend” is defined as a statutory holiday that falls on a weekday and is either adjacent to a weekend or is observed on a nearby weekday.)

| Holiday | Date(s) in 2023 | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-----------------|-------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 (​Sunday) – observed Mon 2 | **Jan 1–2** (Sun–Mon) |
| **Family Day** (Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario) | Feb 20 (Mon) | **Feb 20–21** (Mon–Tue) |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (Fri) | **Apr 7–9** (Fri–Sun) |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Mon) | **May 22–23** (Mon–Tue) |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 (Sat) – observed Mon 3 | **Jul 1–3** (Sat–Mon) |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Mon) | **Sep 4–5** (Mon–Tue) |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Mon) | **Oct 9–10** (Mon–Tue) |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 (Sat) – observed Mon 13 | **Nov 11–13** (Sat–Mon) |
| **Christmas** | Dec 25 (Mon) | **Dec 25–26** (Mon–Tue) |

> **Note:**  
> • Boxing Day falls on Tuesday, Dec 26, 2023, so it does *not* create a long weekend unless you take a day off on Monday or Wednesday.  
> • Some provinces have additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in NL, St. John’s Day in PEI) that may be observed on a nearby weekday, but they’re not federal statutory holidays and therefore aren’t listed here.

Feel free to plug this table into your holiday‑planning app!
